class.name: RDAccelerationStructureGeometry
class.description: [RDAccelerationStructureGeometry] describes a set of triangles used as raytracing geometry in the [method RenderingDevice.blas_create] method. The geometry is always in triangle list form, either indexed or non-indexed. Triangle strips are not supported. Vertex and index data can come from vertex and index buffers or from storage buffers, for example ones written by a compute shader. Every buffer must be created with [constant RenderingDevice.BUFFER_CREATION_DEVICE_ADDRESS_BIT] and [constant RenderingDevice.BUFFER_CREATION_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_BUILD_INPUT_READ_ONLY_BIT], otherwise [method RenderingDevice.blas_create] fails.

members.member: Buffer containing vertex indices. If [code]null[/code], triangles are non-indexed. This is an index buffer created with [method RenderingDevice.index_buffer_create], which uses its own format, or a storage buffer created with [method RenderingDevice.storage_buffer_create], which is read as [member index_format].
Number of indices used by this geometry in [member index_buffer].
Format of the indices when [member index_buffer] is a storage buffer. An index buffer uses the format it was created with, and this property is ignored.
Byte offset of the first index in [member index_buffer].
Buffer containing vertices. This is a vertex buffer created with [method RenderingDevice.vertex_buffer_create] or a storage buffer created with [method RenderingDevice.storage_buffer_create].
Number of vertices used by this geometry in [member vertex_buffer].
Format of the vertices in [member vertex_buffer].
Byte offset of the first vertex in [member vertex_buffer].
Number of bytes between each vertex in [member vertex_buffer].
